summary: Admin Dashboard Directory: change only the Administrative Directory Table Photo column to display photo filenames (text), clickable to open the full-size image in a modal/overlay, to reduce page lag from loading many images at once; no other UI/table behavior may change.
architectural_notes: Only modify Administrative Directory Table 'Photo' column header/cells; no other UI/behavior changes are acceptable.
Replace inline image loading with filename text to prevent simultaneous loading and improve performance.
On filename click, display the full-size image in an overlay/modal.
known_issues: Directory page lags because all leader photos in the Photo column load simultaneously as the leader count increases.

existing_features.title: Update ONLY the Administrative Directory Table Photo column header cell at XPath `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/div[4]/div[1]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/table[1]/thead[1]/tr[1]/th[4]` so that its user-facing label remains unchanged (e.g., still shows the same "Photo" text) and no other table header styling/structure changes occur.

Update ONLY the Administrative Directory Table Photo column body cell at XPath `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/div[4]/div[1]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/table[1]/tbody[1]/tr[1]/td[4]` so that it no longer renders an `` (or any image element) inline. Instead, render the photo *filename as text only* (derived from the representative photo path), styled as a clickable link/button. Clicking the filename must open an overlay/modal showing the full-size image.

Ensure the new Photo modal/overlay behavior is performance-safe: the full-size image request must be initiated only when the user clicks a filename, not during initial table render, and the modal must not trigger any additional directory refetches or mutations.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update Administrative Directory Table Photo column to show clickable photo filename (text) that opens full-size image in a modal/overlay; do not change any other UI/table behavior.

projectName: Admin Directory: Replace Photo column images with clickable filenames and modal preview (no other UI changes)
